text: Under FinCEN guidance a mere user of virtual currency is not a money services business and faces no registration duty, while a user deemed an administrator or exchanger must comply with reporting and recordkeeping regulations.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds

abstract: While a user of a virtual currency is not a MSB and not subject to any registration requirements, a user of virtual currencies who is deemed to be an administrator or exchanger will be required to comply with its reporting and recordkeeping regulations.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: under FinCEN guidance issued in March 2013 extending the Bank Secrecy Act to virtual currencies
